description: Miracle Claw bridge capability — grants the openclaw-host-bridge.js (running on the openclaw gateway at 127.0.0.1:28789 inside the main webview) access to invoke custom Tauri commands. Activated only on the http://127.0.0.1:28789 origin via the `remote` URL pattern. Deliberately scoped to `core:default` only — NO shell:allow-execute or filesystem permissions. The main.json capability (local-only) retains those dangerous permissions and remains the only path to invoke them from the dashboard (tauri://localhost/index.html).
